notes: M money supply, V velocity, P price level, T volume of transactions.

front: Find P from the equation of exchange?

back: The average number of times a unit of money is spent in a period.

front: What does the quantity theory assume?
back: V and T are constant (T at full employment), so P changes in proportion to M.
Inflation is caused by excess growth of the money supply; control money growth to control inflation.

front: Name three criticisms of the quantity theory.
back: Velocity is not constant, T can change when there is spare capacity, and cost-push inflation or reverse causation.

front: Is MV = PT a theory or an identity?
back: An identity: total spending equals the value of transactions. The theory adds that V and T are constant.
